How It Works

Simple from first idea to final pickup

We keep renting easy so you can focus on the fun part: designing a beautiful event.

Browse & build your list

Add pieces to your quote with quantities and finishes. Not sure yet? Add what inspires you and we'll help narrow it down.

Send your request

Share your date, venue, guest count and any notes. Requests are free and there's no obligation.

Get your custom quote

We confirm availability and send a tailored quote, including delivery for your venue.

We deliver & pick up

Our team delivers, places and collects everything, so you never have to lift a chair.

Good to know

Delivery and details

  • Delivery only. Every order is delivered and picked up by our team. We don't offer customer pickup, which keeps every piece in top condition.
  • Quotes are tailored. Pricing depends on your pieces, quantities, date and venue, so we quote every event individually.
  • Book early for peak season. Spring and fall weekends fill quickly in Austin, so reach out as soon as you have a date.
  • Custom pieces take a little longer. Wrapped or custom-built facades and floors need extra lead time; we'll confirm timing with your quote.
